input.quote: 19.2 For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term.
input.rationale: Warranty period: the contract gives 90 days; our redline sets 12 months (i.e. the period is now stated as "12 months", which exceeds the 90 day floor). Sections 19.1-19.5 otherwise meet our position: professional and workmanlike Services by qualified personnel (19.1), material conformity of Services and Deliverables to documentation and specifications (19.1, 19.2), no malicious code and compliance with Applicable Law (19.3), a prompt re-perform/repair/replace remedy escalating to termination and refund of Fees paid that is expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims (19.4), and a disclaimer that expressly does not limit any express warranty, service level, indemnity or remedy (19.5), so the disclaimer does not swallow the express warranties. The only open gap is duration: Deliverables, which under Section 1.4 expressly include configurations and integrations and under Section 13.2 may embed software, carry a conformance window of only 90 days, which is our fallback rather than the preferred 12 months. Hosted Services already conform throughout the subscription term, so the minimal fix is to extend the Deliverable window in 19.2 to 12 months, with the digits placed directly against the unit so the period parses unambiguously, leaving the Hosted Services conformance, the authority warranty, the Section 19.4 remedy and the Section 19.5 carve-out untouched.

ops.oldText: For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria.
ops.newText: For a period of 12 months after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the Deliverable conformance warranty in Section 19.2 from 90 days to 12 months, consistent with our position that delivered software and work product carry a 12 month conformance warranty; the Section 19.4 repair, replacement and refund remedy is unchanged. If 12 months is difficult, we can accept 90 days for non-software Deliverables provided software-bearing Deliverables carry 12 months.
proposal.summary: Extend the Deliverable conformance warranty period in Section 19.2 from 90 days to 12 months.
